summary.text: Ryan Teasdale, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 11th District to Jeremy Moss.
A nonprofit professional, he left a corporate career before running.

paragraphs.text: Teasdale graduated from Waterford Mott High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Oakland University in 2009.
His career experience includes working as a nonprofit professional.
In his Ballotpedia survey he says he left a corporate career last year and started a group that demonstrates the benefits of disagreeing more respectfully.
The Green Party nominated him at its April 25, 2026 convention.
He described his campaign as centered on disagreeing more respectfully, affordable housing, transparency and public safety.
He received 0.7% of the vote to Jeremy Moss's 60.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
